column4: A drawing of the sun: a circle with a dot in the middle, squared off by the brush.
A crescent moon with two lines of shadow; one cycle of it is a month.
A person standing with arms and legs spread wide, as big as they can be.
A vertical line with a knot on it, the old way of marking ten; later the knot became a crossbar.
A forked stick used as a shield. In 年 and 平 it is only a shape.
A slash 丿 of a sickle over a field drying 干 in the sun: one harvest is one year.
A person walking, seen from the side: two legs.
A single line.
A baby wrapped in swaddling cloth, arms out, legs tucked into one.
A sprout pushing up out of the earth 土: to be born, to live, raw.
A field divided by paths into four plots.
A wooden fence of planks, built for use.
An old person with long hair flowing down, leaning on a staff. Long, and the eldest who leads.
Three peaks, the middle one highest.
A hand with fingers spread over the wrist.
A tree: trunk, branches up, roots down.
A tree 木 with a mark at its root: where something starts.
The sun 日 rising behind a tree 木 in the east.
An open mouth. As a part it also means an opening or a box.
A line 丨 through the middle of a box 口.
A lid 人一 placed on a pot 口: they fit together.
An eye turned upright: the top and bottom boxes are eyelids, the middle one the iris.
Water flowing between two banks.
A foot stepping out of an enclosure 凵; it later came to look like two mountains 山.
Three small dots, grains of sand.
An eye 目 watching over small 小 villages: an administrative district.
A nose. Japanese point at their nose when they say "me".
An arrowhead, or a way in, with one stroke going into the other.
A child 子 under a roof 冖 with sparks of knowledge ⺍ above: a school.
A cart seen from above: axle through the middle, two wheels as crossbars.
Water plants floating on a flat surface; the shape is a shield 干 with two dots.
A woman kneeling with her hands crossed.
A gate with two swinging doors.
The sun 日 seen through the gap of a gate 門: the space between.
A short mark above a line 一; the mark grew into 卜.
A short mark below a line 一; the mark grew into 卜.
The sun 日 and the moon 月 together: as bright as it gets.
A mouth 口 calling out a number.
A plough, or an arm flexing its muscle.
Three lines.
Chariots 車 under a cover 冖: an army camp.
The one who connects heaven, people and earth (三 joined by 丨).
A king 王 under a roof 人: everything is in his care.
A crescent moon 月 missing a stroke, low in the sky: evening.
In the evening 夕, when you can't see faces, you say your name with your mouth 口.
Fortune-telling 卜 at evening 夕 was done outside.
A bird's nest: birds return to the nest when the sun sets in the west.
Two pieces of meat 夕 stacked: plenty.
One 一 mouth 口 in a frame 冂: everyone saying the same thing.
A person 人 entering a frame 冂: inside.
A person 大 standing on the ground 一.
A town ⻏ split 咅 into sections.
A plough with a handle, pointing in a direction.
Cloth 巾 hung under a roof 亠 at a market stall.
A tall building on a hill: a palace, the capital.
Two lines.
People 人 under one roof coming to say 云 something: a meeting.
A person 亻 making things with a saw 乍.
A crossroads seen from above; 彳 is its left half.
A person 亻 and their origin 本: the body.
Where a person 亻 stands 立: their rank and position.
A tall watchtower: roof 亠, window 口, and a frame below 冋.
A stream with drops splashing off both sides.
Three boxes 口 of goods stacked up.
Strength 力 and a mouth 口: cheering adds to the effort.
Two hands 开 pushing a gate 門 open.
A field 田 with a sprout coming out: the cause from which things grow.
A field 由 drawn inside a frame 凵: a picture, or the strokes of a brush.
A lump of soil on the ground.
An altar 礻 to the god of the earth 土, where the village gathered.
A person 亻 standing on the earth 土: to be there.
An old man 耂 under the sun 日: someone who has done things.
A hand with a dot where the pulse is, one inch from the wrist.
Earth 土 and hand 寸: a place built by hand on the ground.
The sun 日 by the temple 寺: temples rang the hours. 寺 gives the sound じ.
Trees 木 and hands 寸 that work them: a village.
A person with a pattern tattooed on the chest; later writing.
Writing 文 in one hand 寸: answering face to face.
A hand holding a stone axe or a stick.
A person with crossed legs.
Under the trees 木, children mix 交: school. 交 gives the sound こう.
Two strokes splitting apart; "to divide" before it was "eight".
To divide 八 what is private 厶: public.
A knife or a single-edged sword.
A knife 刀 cutting something in two 八.
An axe with a handle.
Standing 立 trees 木 chopped by an axe 斤: fresh wood, new.
A one-leaf door, half of 門.
A door 戸 and an axe 斤: the place where you live and work.
A string of jade beads 王 with one more dot 丶 to tell it from king.
A jewel 玉 inside borders 囗: a country.
A lamp with a flame 丶 on top: the one who keeps the fire, the master.
A whirl: a box 口 inside a box 囗.
A person 人 holding a tool: by means of.
A person 亻 putting up a stake 弋 to hold a place: in place of, generation.
A carpenter's square or a tool.
A stake 弋 and a tool 工: a formal way of doing things.
A body with a big belly, seen from the side.
Earth 土 with 也: the ground.
Nuggets 丶 buried in the earth 土 under a roof 人: gold, metal, money.
Two hands 八 holding something up together.
A big eye 目 on legs 儿: a person looking.
A jewel 王 that you can see 見: it appears.
Feet 癶 setting off on two 二 legs 儿.
A person 儿 with a big head 二: the top, the beginning.
A town ⻏ full of people 者: a metropolis.
A frame 冂 with ten 十 and a shield 干: a bell hung on the south side.
Horns 䒑 above a moon 月 and a knife 刂: cutting the way ahead.
A step 彳 slowed by thread 幺 on dragging feet 夂: you are behind.
A person 大 with a big line 一 over the head: the sky.
A gate 門 that can be closed 关: a checkpoint, a connection.
A face with its outline around the eyes.
Grain 禾 in every mouth 口: peace.
Ten 十 over one 一: a man who can do many things, a samurai.
A samurai 士 under a cover 冖 on his legs 儿, selling wares.
A hand 寸 inside an enclosure 囗: a group.
Words coming out of a mouth 口.
A person 亻 and their words 言: trust.
人 squeezed to the left side.
水 reduced to three drops.
手 reduced to fit on the left side.
火 at the bottom of a character, as four flames.
心 standing upright on the left side.
A road with a foot on it: moving along.
The roof of a house.
A cloth or lid over something.
Two sprouts of grass.
